items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: He didn't work with them, he set in with us. Him and Muggsy.

ctx.x: He didn't work with them, he set in with us. Him and Muggsy. Oh yeah? Yeah, him and Muggsy. You mean they came in together? Yes. Who were you working with? Oh, just a little patched up band, wasn't any name band. We were just playing in this place. I'm trying to get a man named him in that place. There was about five of us. Paradise Inn, let's call it. 35th and Prairie.
